governance.voting_structure: Two classes of ordinary shares (Class A and Class X), each entitled to one vote per share, voting together: "Each shareholder of record is entitled to one vote per Class A ordinary share and one vote per Class X ordinary share on each matter submitted to a vote of shareholders."
